public_strategic_priorities: Accelerating digital care delivery for over 47 million members.
Optimizing clinical models with generative AI to lower administrative overhead.

prior_authorization.current_pain_point: Manual prior authorization reviews take an average of 4-5 days, risking non-compliance with the 72-hour turnaround requirements under CMS-0057-F.
prior_authorization.gcp_solution_play: Healthcare Data Engine (HDE) for clinical data harmonization + Vertex AI Search for Healthcare + Gemini Med for automated clinical document parsing and compliance checks.

claims_processing.current_pain_point: High rate of first-pass claims denials due to poor de-identification pipeline speeds and ICD-10 coding errors.
claims_processing.gcp_solution_play: Cloud Healthcare API FHIR store + BigQuery ML + Google Cloud DLP API pipeline.

public_strategic_priorities: Pioneering multi-modal clinical AI search across pathology and imaging.
Deploying secure, distributed AI clinical support systems globally.

clinical_search.current_pain_point: Pathologists spend hours searching across disconnected EHR systems, PACS imaging servers, and genomics databases for diagnostic lookalikes.
clinical_search.gcp_solution_play: Vertex AI Search for Healthcare + Medical Imaging Suite + High-Performance Computing (HPC) for multi-modal semantic indexing.

provider_onboarding.current_pain_point: Credentialing and onboarding new clinical staff is heavily paper-based, taking 45-60 days per physician.
provider_onboarding.gcp_solution_play: Document AI for Healthcare + AppSheet workflows.
